What does carpet installation cost in Marysville, WA?

Plan on $4 to $7 per square foot installed in Marysville — that covers the carpet, the pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away of the old carpet. A single bedroom usually lands around $600–$1,000, and most full Marysville projects come in between $2,400 and $3,900. Carpet grade moves the number most, and you pick it from full-size samples laid on your own floor.
Does the mobile carpet showroom come out to Marysville?

Yes, Marysville is regular territory for the van. It shows up with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades; we spread them through the rooms being carpeted so colors read under your own windows, then measure every room and stair and leave a written price before we go. The visit is free and replaces the store trip entirely.
How much is carpet stretching in Marysville?

Carpet stretching in Marysville starts at $99 per room, and most rooms finish between $99 and $180. The power stretcher pulls ripples, waves and trip spots flat again for roughly a fifth of what replacement costs — the right call whenever the pile still stands up and you can live with the color.
What do carpeted stairs cost in Marysville?

Stair carpet starts at $18 per step in waterfall or cap-and-band style, and a typical Marysville staircase totals $235–$400. Landings and pie-shaped corner steps are measured and priced in the written quote from the start, so the invoice matches the quote with no add-ons appearing later.
How long will my carpet installation take?

One day covers most Marysville homes. Three or four bedrooms plus a staircase is a normal day's work for the crew; a packed two-story can run into a second day. The schedule goes on your written quote, so you'll know before install day whether the kids sleep in their own rooms that night.
Do you move furniture during the install?

We do — beds, couches, dressers and tables are included on most jobs, and everything goes back where it belongs afterward. Your part is the small stuff: closet floors, toys, electronics, breakables and anything you'd rather carry yourself. If a piano or an aquarium is in the picture, mention it at the measure so we plan for it.
Should we stretch our carpet or replace it?

Stretch when the pile stands up, the backing is intact and the color still works — that's a $99-per-room repair instead of a full replacement. Replace when traffic paths stay matted, seams split, the backing crumbles, or pet odor outlives a professional cleaning. We look first and tell you which one you actually need before any quote.

All of Marysville — downtown around the old water tower, Sunnyside, Shoultes, Pinewood, Kellogg Marsh, Marshall, Cedarcrest, Getchell Hill, Whiskey Ridge, Soper Hill, Jennings Park, Lakewood and Smokey Point — plus Tulalip, Priest Point and the neighboring towns. If you're within about an hour of Marysville, the van still makes the trip.
Which carpet holds up best with dogs and kids?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing over a moisture-barrier pad. The backing and barrier keep accidents from reaching the subfloor — where permanent odor starts — and the fiber shrugs off diluted bleach without fading. For families who log hours at the Strawberry Fields off-leash park, it's the setup we point to first. The pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot.
What warranty comes with the job?

Every install carries OC Flooring's 1-year workmanship warranty, and the carpet carries the mill's warranty on top — usually 10 to 25 years against wear and stains depending on grade. Both appear on your written quote. Worth knowing: some mill warranties require a minimum pad grade to stay valid, which is one reason all three pad grades come along to the measure.
